Data protection that checks all the boxes
Doxis is EU GDPR compliant
With Doxis, you meet the requirements of the EU General Data Protection Regulation.
The internationally renowned auditing firm, Ebner Stolz, confirms it: Doxis meets the data protection requirements of the EU GDPR, which came into effect on May 25, 2018. With Doxis, you can protect, store, delete and provide personal data in compliance with the EU GDPR. You meet important requirements such as the right to erasure (Art. 17 EU GDPR), the right to data portability (Art. 20 EU GDPR) and the secure processing of personal data (Art. 32 EU GDPR).
Doxis audit
Ebner Stolz confirmed that Doxis CSB, Doxis cubeDesigner and Doxis safeLock are EU GDPR-compliant. The independent auditors confirm that these solutions are suitable for processing, storing, providing and deleting personal data in conformance with data protection guidelines: When used correctly and in conjunction with organizational control mechanisms, they enable you to fulfill data protection requirements in accordance with the EU GDPR.
